tools.name: find_available_providers
tools.description: Find a person to do something in a named place, and say which of them are ACTUALLY FREE RIGHT NOW. Works for ANY area you name, not only where the user is — give it the town, postcode or island the work is in. A property, client, guest or relative somewhere else is a normal case. tools.name: notify_me_when_free
tools.description: Ask Speedi to tell somebody the moment a particular business sets its light green. Use this when nobody is free now and the person wants one business in particular — it is the answer to "nobody is available", not a consolation. You need the provider's id from find_available_providers and an email ad

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Speedi for local tradespeople and services, and whether they are free right now. `query` is the search terms: what is wanted and where, such as 'plumber Chorley' or 'boiler repair PR7'. Returns businesses to cite; call `fetch` with an id for the full record.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full Speedi record for one business by the id returned from `search`, including their live availability, what they do, and where they are reviewed.

tools.name: check_provider_availability
tools.description: Check whether one specific named business is free right now on Speedi, and when they last set their availability. Use this when someone names a business rather than a trade.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_available_providers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
